title: Card stopped location
prompt: Where did the card stop working?

ja.prompt: カードはどこで使えなくなりましたか？
ja.hint: 「at the supermarket（スーパーで）」と答えましょう。

local.prompt: Where did the card stop working?

local_pron.prompt: wɛər dɪd ðə kɑrd stɑp ˈwɜrkɪŋ?

en.prompt: Where did the card stop working?

title: Teller's explanation
prompt: What did the teller say about the card?
hint: Say: 'It was blocked due to unusual activity.'
sample: It was blocked due to unusual activity.

ja.prompt: 窓口の担当者はカードについて何と言いましたか？
ja.hint: 「It was blocked due to unusual activity.（不審な取引で停止されました）」と答えましょう。
ja.sample: 不審な取引で停止されました。

local.prompt: What did the teller say about the card?
local.hint: Say: 'It was blocked due to unusual activity.'
local.sample: It was blocked due to unusual activity.

local_pron.prompt: wɒt dɪd ðə ˈtɛlər seɪ əˈbaʊt ðə kɑrd?
local_pron.hint: seɪ: ɪt wəz blɒkt djuː tuː ʌnˈjuːʒuəl ækˈtɪvɪti
local_pron.sample: ɪt wəz blɒkt djuː tuː ʌnˈjuːʒuəl ækˈtɪvɪti

zh.prompt: 櫃檯人員怎麼說你的卡？
zh.hint: 說：「It was blocked due to unusual activity.（因為異常活動而被封鎖）」。
zh.sample: 因為有異常活動卡被封鎖了。

en.prompt: What did the teller say about the card?
en.hint: Say: 'It was blocked due to unusual activity.'
en.sample: It was blocked due to unusual activity.

en_pron.prompt: wɒt dɪd ðə ˈtɛlər seɪ əˈbaʊt ðə kɑːrd?

title: Decision about the card
prompt: What did the speaker decide to do about the card?
hint: Say: 'Get a new card and confirm the address.'
sample: Get a new card and confirm the address.

ja.prompt: 話者はカードについてどう決めましたか？
ja.hint: 「Get a new card and confirm the address.（新しいカードを作り、住所を確認する）」と答えましょう。
ja.sample: 新しいカードを作り、住所を確認しました。

local.prompt: What did the speaker decide to do about the card?
local.hint: Say: 'Get a new card and confirm the address.'
local.sample: Get a new card and confirm the address.

local_pron.prompt: wɒt dɪd ðə ˈspiːkər dɪˈsaɪd tuː duː əˈbaʊt ðə kɑrd?
local_pron.hint: seɪ: ɡɛt ə njuː kɑrd ænd kənˈfɜːrm ði əˈdrɛs

zh.prompt: 說話者決定對這張卡做什麼？
zh.hint: 回答：「Get a new card and confirm the address.（申請新卡並確認地址）」。
zh.sample: 我決定申請新卡並確認送卡地址。
